repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a one-shot wait followed by an infinite cycle of email notifications. The candidate incorrectly executes the close valve and email in the `else` branch, causing the valve to close every 60 seconds (at t=60000, 120000, etc.) after the initial wait, whereas the IR only closes the valve once at the start and then only emails repeatedly.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the valve close and email calls from the `else` branch. The IR cycle has no stop condition (`until: null`), so the script must not terminate. The body (email) must repeat every period without re-executing the pre-cycle actions (wait, close valve). The fix removes the duplicate actions from the `else` block, leaving only the email call to repeat.
